re_vs_ee_visualizations

2025-07-07

ee_vs_re = load_differential_analysis(selected_omes = "all",
                                      selected_tissues = "muscle",
                                      single_matrix = TRUE) 
## Please remember that the lowest CV Metabolite is chosen and the
##             relevant refmet name is used. If you're not able to find your desired
##             metabolite, look through the METABOLOMICS_CV object for the relevant
##             refmet/feature name.
ee_re_sig = ee_vs_re %>%
  filter(contrast_type == "Endur_vs_Resist") %>%
  # filter(adj_p_value < 0.05) %>%
  select(tissue, assay, feature_id, Timepoint, adj_p_value, logFC)

ee_re_wide = ee_vs_re %>%
  filter(contrast_type == "exercise_no_controls") %>%
  select(tissue, assay, feature_id, Timepoint, randomGroupCode, logFC, adj_p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("randomGroupCode"),
              values_from = c("logFC", "adj_p_value")) %>%
  merge(., ee_re_sig, by = c("tissue", "assay", "feature_id", "Timepoint")) %>%
  mutate(sig_contrast = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "Sig", "Non-Sig"),
         sig_ee_single = ifelse(adj_p_value_ADUEndur < 0.05, "Sig", "Non-Sig"),
         sig_re_single = ifelse(adj_p_value_ADUResist < 0.05, "Sig", "Non-Sig"))

categorized = ee_re_wide %>%
  mutate(
    fill_category = case_when(
      sig_ee_single == "Sig" & sig_re_single == "Non-Sig" ~ "EE",
      sig_ee_single == "Non-Sig" & sig_re_single == "Sig" ~ "RE",
      sig_ee_single == "Sig" & sig_re_single == "Sig" ~ "Both",
      TRUE ~ "Not sig in either"
    ),
    border_color = case_when(
      sig_contrast == "Sig" ~ "black",
      fill_category == "EE" ~ "orange",
      fill_category == "RE" ~ "green",
      fill_category == "Both" ~ "brown",
      TRUE ~ "grey"
    )
  ) 

categorized %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC_ADUEndur, y = logFC_ADUResist)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_category, color = border_color),
             size = 1,
             stroke = 1,
             shape = 21) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "EE" = "orange",
      "RE" = "green",
      "Both" = "brown",
      "Not sig in either" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (ADUEndur)", 
    y = "logFC (ADUResist)",
    title = "ADUEndur vs ADUResist logFC (only muscle)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ assay) +
  theme_minimal()

So above I have the initial representation but its a bit messy and doesn’t fit the format that we’re going for.

lowest_p_val_per_re_vs_ee = categorized %>%
  group_by(feature_id) %>%
  slice_min(adj_p_value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(assay != "prot-pr", 
         sig_contrast == "Sig")


lowest_p_val_per_re_vs_ee %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC_ADUEndur, y = logFC_ADUResist)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_category, color = border_color),
             size = 1.5,
             stroke = 0.1,
             shape = 21) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "EE" = "orange",
      "RE" = "green",
      "Both" = "brown",
      "Not sig in either" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (ADUEndur)", 
    y = "logFC (ADUResist)",
    title = "ADUEndur vs ADUResist logFC (Sig feat only, muscle only, lowest p val per feat)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ assay, nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal()

lowest_p_val_per_re_vs_ee %>%
  filter(fill_category != "Not sig in either") %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC_ADUEndur, y = logFC_ADUResist)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = assay, color = border_color),
             size = 1.5,
             stroke = 0.1,
             shape = 21) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "transcript-rna-seq" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["transcript-rna-seq"]],
      "prot-ph" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["prot-ph"]],
      "metab" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["Metabolomics"]]
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (ADUEndur)", 
    y = "logFC (ADUResist)",
    title = "ADUEndur vs ADUResist logFC (Sig feat only, muscle only, lowest p val per feat)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ fill_category, nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal()

most_diff_features = lowest_p_val_per_re_vs_ee %>%
  filter(fill_category == "Not sig in either") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  # left_join(trimmed_feat_gene, by = "feature_id") %>%
  # mutate(label_use = case_when(is.na(gene_symbol) ~ feature_id,
  #                              TRUE ~ gene_symbol)) %>%
  pull(feature_id)

trimmed_feat_gene = HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE %>% select(feature_id, gene_symbol)

lowest_p_val_per_re_vs_ee %>%
  filter(fill_category == "Not sig in either") %>%
  left_join(trimmed_feat_gene, by = "feature_id") %>%
  mutate(label_use = case_when(is.na(gene_symbol) ~ feature_id,
                               TRUE ~ gene_symbol)) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC_ADUEndur, y = logFC_ADUResist)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = assay, color = border_color),
             size = 1.5,
             stroke = 0.7,
             shape = 21) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "transcript-rna-seq" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["transcript-rna-seq"]],
      "prot-ph" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["prot-ph"]],
      "metab" = HUMAN_OME_COLORS[["Metabolomics"]]
    )
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(feature_id %in% most_diff_features),
    aes(label = label_use),
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (ADUEndur)", 
    y = "logFC (ADUResist)",
    title = "Only divergent features"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
